profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd describes itself as a world's leading autonomous aerial vehicle technology platform company. Its stated mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. The company says it provides customers in various industries with autonomous aerial vehicle products and commercial solutions, including urban air mobility for passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. Its website also lists innovative products for passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions.

The company positions itself as a forerunner of cutting-edge autonomous aerial vehicle technologies and commercial solutions in the global Urban Air Mobility industry. The available site text does not name specific AI products, but frames its autonomous aerial vehicle technology as the core offering. It trades as NASDAQ: EH.

EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, with ticker EH and SEC CIK 0001759783. It is also listed under the alias EHANG HOLDINGS LTD-SPS ADR. The available data includes no litigation records.
